definitions.explanation: Casual, internet-flavored slang for an outstanding, deeply moving song — a "god-tier tune." Formed from {神|かみ} (god, used as an intensifier) and {曲|きょく} (musical piece).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神曲|しんきょく}だ。
examples.english: This song is an absolute masterpiece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神曲|しんきょく}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧だ。
examples.english: Her new song is the talk of the town as a masterpiece.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{神曲|しんきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: The venue got fired up as one great song after another played at the concert.

notes:
USAGE: As slang, {神曲|しんきょく} means an outstanding, unforgettable song. The prefix ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧/{神|しん} is widely used to intensify praise (compare ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧, "god-tier response").

NOTE ON OTHER MEANING: The same characters {神曲|しんきょく} are also the Japanese title of Dante's Divine Comedy; context makes clear which is meant.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名曲|めいきょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧: a famous, classic song — an established masterpiece, not slang
- ⟦{新曲|しんきょく}→新曲：12983_shinkyoku⟧: a new song — a homophone; a newly released track
